reason: The README clearly describes this as a DeepSeek Harness service-management plugin focused on connecting to and managing remote services (SSH/FTP, multiple databases, Docker, and S3-compatible storage), with session-level @server references and remote terminal/file transfer capabilities, so the primary user-facing purpose is external service integration and operations.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek 会话中提供远程服务管理入口，可连接 SSH/FTP、数据库、Docker 和对象存储服务，并支持 SFTP 文件传输与远程终端等会话化操作。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a DeepSeek Harness interface for managing remote services such as SSH/FTP, databases, Docker, and S3-like storage, including session-time @server references plus SFTP file transfer and remote terminal operations.

capabilities: manage remote services over SSH, databases, Docker, and object storage
transfer files and open remote terminal sessions
reference and invoke remote servers inside conversations via @server

reasons.code: README feature list includes FTP, SSH, Redis, MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Elasticsearch, Docker, MongoDB, Cassandra, and S3/MinIO/R2.
README states SSH SFTP 文件上传下载和远程终端.
Repository description states the plugin is a service manager for SSH, FTP, databases, Docker and S3 with @server references.

capabilities: manage remote services over SSH, databases, Docker, and object storage
transfer files and open remote terminal sessions
reference and invoke remote servers inside conversations via @server
